categories.name: Shows
categories.description: Complete shows, each playing a scripted demo.

examples.title: Car dashboard
examples.description: A digital instrument cluster driven by variables: bars, shift lights, gear, warning lamps, turn signals.

examples.title: Departure board
examples.description: An airport departure board made of segment displays, with no assets at all.

examples.title: Pinball DMD
examples.description: A 128x32 dot-matrix display of glowing dots with six scenes: score layouts, a jackpot in full color, a night drive video mode and a segment display.

examples.title: Slot machine
examples.description: Three reels of SVG symbols that spin whole turns and stop one after another behind a window of three, with a whir, a clunk per reel, rolling credits and a cabinet that flashes on a paying line.

examples.title: Streamer overlay
examples.description: A live stream overlay on a stand-in for the game capture: alerts that pop in with a chime, a lower third, a follower goal bar, a viewer count, and starting-soon and be-right-back screens.

examples.title: Weather dashboard
examples.description: A weather kiosk on a day that runs in two minutes: a sky and sun that follow the clock, animated icons for the conditions, a five-day forecast and hourly bars, all from variables a host would feed.

categories.name: Layers
categories.description: The layer tree: what is painted, where, and in which order.

examples.title: Shapes
examples.description: Rectangles and circles, painted in order, in the layer's local space, with translucent fills.

examples.title: Opacity
examples.description: Opacity multiplies down the tree: a fading group takes its children along.

examples.title: Scale and anchor
examples.description: The anchor decides which point of a layer stays at its x/y while it scales.

examples.title: Group clip
examples.description: A group with a rect or circle clip is a window onto its children.

examples.title: Paths and vectors
examples.description: Path shapes filled, stroked or both, a group clipped by a path, and SVG artwork drawn by a vector layer at its own size or sized.

examples.title: Blend modes
examples.description: The same lamp glow over dark art as add, screen, multiply and normal, and two overlapping glows in one add group next to two add layers.

examples.title: Rotation and transforms
examples.description: A needle whose rotation follows a variable, a compass on a 360 ring, a spinning fan, a clipped group that turns as one, a mirrored word and a stretch from scale_x and scale_y.

categories.name: Images
categories.description: PNG files from the show's assets folder.

examples.title: Image
examples.description: An image at its natural size, sized into the canvas, anchored, scaled, faded and moved.

examples.title: Sprite sheet
examples.description: One image as a grid of cells; the frame property picks the cell, from a timeline, a binding or the base value.

examples.title: Image tint
examples.description: A tint multiplies an image's colors and leaves its transparency alone: one white bulb in four colors, a status light whose tint is mapped from a variable and fades between colors, tinted glows added over dark art, and a speckle multiplied over clean art.

categories.name: Text
categories.description: Three ways to put characters on the canvas.

examples.title: Bitmap font
examples.description: BMFont pixel fonts on a small canvas: color, border, alignment in a box, multiple lines.

examples.title: Outline font
examples.description: A TrueType font at any size from one file: styles, borders, alignment, and a scale that stays sharp.

examples.title: Digit rows
examples.description: Segment displays without any asset: alpha14 and numeric7, unlit segments, justification, the dot.

examples.title: Reel rows
examples.description: Digit cells that roll through a ring of characters drawn in a font: a staggered score odometer, a letter board, and the same step fast and slow.

categories.name: Bindings
categories.description: Properties wired to the variables the host sets.

examples.title: Scale and offset
examples.description: One variable drives x, y, scale and opacity, each through its own scale and offset.

examples.title: Text and format
examples.description: Numbers, booleans and text bound to a display: plain, with thousands separators, scaled first.

examples.title: Map and default
examples.description: A state variable looked up in a map: lamps, a status text, and what happens to unlisted values.

examples.title: Font binding
examples.description: The font style of a text layer mapped from a variable: highlighting the active player's score.

examples.title: Transitions
examples.description: Bindings that ease to a new value instead of jumping: bars, a smoothed slow feed, a counting score, a fading lamp, and step and offset: a bar that goes 10 pixels past and back, a reel kicked on digit by digit.

examples.title: Visible, threshold, debounce
examples.description: A bound visible that shows a lamp and swaps two pages, a threshold that snaps a level, and a debounce that lets a strobe pass unseen.

examples.title: Easing
examples.description: The eight easings side by side on the same two keys.

examples.title: Delay, repeat, loop
examples.description: The same timeline played once, delayed, three times, two and a half times, and forever.

examples.title: on_end
examples.description: Timelines that fire the next one's trigger when they end: a chase that runs without a host.

examples.title: Trigger lists
examples.description: A timeline listening to several triggers: turn signals that also blink together as hazard lights.

examples.title: Precedence
examples.description: A running timeline beats a binding, a binding beats the base value.

categories.name: Scenes
categories.description: Switchable views on top of the show's own layers.

examples.title: Scenes
examples.description: Attract, game and game over: one scene at a time, each restarting its timelines when entered.

categories.name: Sound
categories.description: Audio layers: sounds played the way timelines are.

examples.title: Audio layers
examples.description: A looping bed whose group gain follows a variable, one coin trigger under three retrigger policies, a delayed repeat whose end lights a lamp, a stop trigger, and a scene with its own loop.

categories.name: Output
categories.description: How the finished frame reaches the display.

examples.title: Output modes
examples.description: The same colors as rgb, gray4 and gray2 with a tint, the way a monochrome DMD shows them.

examples.title: Scaling
examples.description: A 128x32 canvas brought up to the page in whole pixel_perfect blocks, or smooth.

examples.title: Dots
examples.description: The dot matrix look, a pass on the shown frame: round or square dots, their size, a color for dots that are off, and a glow.

categories.name: Events
categories.description: What the show tells its host.

examples.title: Show events
examples.description: Triggers the show fires itself come back to the host as events; watch the log.
